correctness.rationale: A fixed-priority induction gives the exact 0/1 coupled support for every wheel. The path first-edge recursion yields G(z)=z(1-exp(-2z))/(2(1-z)^2), the linear constant rho, and superfactorially vanishing path correction. Before the hub is used at least half of eligible edges are spokes, so early rim dimers have geometric count; their locations are widely separated with high probability. Conditional on first spoke, residual paths have fresh independent greedy orders and their additive boundary corrections cancel when the occupied blocks are separated. Uniform integrability handles rare small separations and negligible no-spoke probability. This proves wheel mean rho(n+1)+o(1), cycle mean rho n+o(1), and Bernoulli total-variation convergence. A standalone checker produced 49,615 exact/computational assertions; finite calculations are diagnostic, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The high-degree apex is a singular but natural one-vertex perturbation of a cycle. Its asymptotic extra matching contribution is an order-one Bernoulli variable with explicit probability rho, despite having unbounded degree; this information is invisible to the known first-order jammed density. The result gives a rigorous perturbation law and a useful benchmark for robustness of stochastic greedy matching, not an arbitrary or routine numerical recomputation.
